remarks:
Welcome to Main Street in Newfane! This impressive 2-story, all-brick Colonial at 2840 Lockport-Olcott Rd offers over 2,000 sq. ft. of living space, blending turn-of-the-century character with modern updates.

The second floor features 4 large, spacious bedrooms, while the first floor den/study offers the possibility of a 5th bedroom. The beautifully renovated 4-piece full bathroom features heated floors, a custom-tiled oversized shower, and a large soaking tub. A convenient half bath and first-floor laundry add to the home’s functionality.

Throughout the home, you’ll find custom woodworking, classic architectural details, and dual staircases leading to the second floor. Additional updates include an updated furnace and hot water tank, along with 200-amp electrical service.

Enjoy the outdoors from the beautiful open-air front porch or the wood wraparound rear deck overlooking the property. A spacious 3-bay detached garage features propane heat and electric—perfect for vehicles, storage, a workshop, or recreational equipment.

Best of all, this unique property sits along the waterfront of Eighteen Mile Creek, offering a picturesque setting right in Newfane. A wonderful combination of space, craftsmanship, character, waterfront, and garage space that is hard to find!
